page.layout: One engraved bookplate, with its caption in a single line below the image. The marbled paper around it is the binding, not printed text.
page.notes: The plate is an engraved ex libris in a rectangular frame. Inside an ornamental cartouche with scrollwork and a mask at the top stands a Latin cross on a rocky mound. The caption is in a italic-style engraved type, with a period after "Caietani". The text is as read from the scan and is clear. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. Marbled endpaper and a metal clasp surround the plate and are not transcribed.
